## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Tiladakkhiṇavimānavatthu* ("Sesame-Gift Mansion", Vv 10) is a verse narrative belonging to the *Vimānavatthu* section of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. The text revolves around the karmic principle that even a modest offering—specifically a gift of sesame seeds given to the Supreme Buddha—generates immense spiritual merit leading to rebirth in a heavenly mansion [SuttaCentral]. Six translations in six modern languages are registered for the text on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
No direct external parallels are recorded on SuttaCentral, and DharmaNexus records no cross-language parallels meeting its scoring threshold [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, DharmaNexus records 192 Pali-internal matches across 34 texts, reflecting extensive shared formulaic verses across celestial mansion stories [DharmaNexus]. It shares substantial verse material with its commentary, the *Vimānavatthu-aṭṭhakathā* (§1.1–8.4), and the *Petavatthu-aṭṭhakathā* (§0.4–3.4), as well as sister texts in the *Vimānavatthu*, notably *Dutiyasuṇisāvimānavatthu* (Vv 14), *Paṭhamasuṇisāvimānavatthu* (Vv 13), *Guttilavimānavatthu* (Vv 33), and the *Pīṭhavimānavatthu* narratives (Vv 3 and Vv 4) [DharmaNexus].
